fields.name: memory_limit
fields.label: Memory limit
fields.help: Optional. The most memory this app's own container may use. Left empty it gets 256m, which is what this app has been measured to need — set it lower and the app may not start, and it will fail as a 502 with nothing about memory to explain it. Any database this app brings has its own separate ceiling.

fields.name: cpu_limit
fields.label: CPU limit
fields.help: Optional. How many CPU cores this app's own container may use — 1 for one full core, 0.5 for half. This server has 4, and Docker will not start a container asking for more. Left empty there is no CPU limit at all. Going past this does not kill anything; the container waits, so the symptom is slowness rather than an error. Any database this app brings is not limited by it.

starter_files./etc/searxng/settings.yml:
# SearXNG settings for this app (one-click recipe, RC-46).
# Based on the image's own settings.template.yml: every setting not listed here
# comes from SearXNG's defaults (use_default_settings).
# https://docs.searxng.org/admin/settings/
#
# server.secret_key is not in this file: the container gets the generated key
# in SEARXNG_SECRET, which overrides it. Edit this file in the File Manager,
# then restart the app.

use_default_settings: true

general:
  instance_name: "SearXNG"

search:
  # json lets AI apps (Open WebUI, LibreChat, Agent Zero ...) use
  # /search?q=<query>&format=json
  formats:
    - html
    - json

server:
  # Private instance behind the panel's password gate, so no rate limiter
  # (it would also need a Valkey service).
  limiter: false
  public_instance: false
  image_proxy: true
